Index funds sound simple. Pick any index, start an SIP, stay invested. But if two funds are tracking the same index, does it really matter which one you choose?
In this video, we break down 3 things every index fund investor should know: the metrics you should check apart from returns, the common mistakes that can hamper the returns you earn, and we also have a strategy for you to help you get better returns from your index funds.
You can use these excel sheets, enter your own data, and see how the numbers play out for you.
